summary: Enhance your skills with our Risk Management in Property Management Training Course. Learn to identify, assess, and mitigate risks effectively.
lede: Property risk management is the process of identifying, assessing, treating, monitoring, and reporting risks across buildings and property portfolios. For property and facilities managers, this course covers building and ranking risk registers, evaluating controls and contractor or lease exposures, planning maintenance and continuity actions, and reporting risk trends through dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or support decisions about building safety, tenant obligations, asset protection, service providers, continuity, and property risk reporting. It suits experienced practitioners who want a structured method for improving portfolio controls and escalating material exposures.
prerequisites: You need practical exposure to property or facilities operations and basic spreadsheet skills. No programming is required, and the exercises use instructor-provided scenarios, templates, and sample property data. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended for dashboard and risk register exercises. Bring anonymized examples of a risk register, inspection record, lease obligation, incident report, or contractor assessment if your organization permits.
